title: Senior Backend-Developer – Agents (100% Remote)
description:
We're looking for Senior Developers to join our fully remote team to work on our agents. If you like complexity and want your work to actually matter, you'll fit right in.
About Us
is an all-in-one platform for property management companies with features like an Inbox, CRM, Documents, Telephony, Video Calls, Team Chat and AI-Agents. Our mission is to automate everything a property manager does.
About the role
Our platform has been an agentic platform since day one. Before we even planned the UI, we planned the way agents would interact with the software. Remember - our goal is to automate the entire industry and we mean it.
As of now, almost everything the user can do in the UI, we have an agent tool for it and the Co-Pilot (daily assistant of the user) can do everything for them, even toggling dark mode on and off.
But the Co-Pilot is just the beginning. The real challenge is the autonomous agents. More on that below.
What you’ll be working on

• Inbox-Agents : Autonomous Agents triggered whenever something new happens inside a ticket. The customer can train them on their own OR rather use one of the templates you will build for them. These agents already have the capabilities to fully own entire complex scenarios and are one of the main reasons customers are interested in our software. But when should the agent escalate to a human rather than finishing on its own? How can we make sure it sticks to the process? Those are your questions.

• Harness Engineering: The agent has 100+ tools. But it has to read a request the way a property manager would, not the way the words sound elsewhere. What goes into the system prompt, what into skills?

• Knowledge base : Our platform includes its own knowledge base, similar to Notion. It’s fully custom built and supposed to act as the companys collective brain. But should the AI also “learn” by itself? And if yes, when? And how can we improve the way our AI searches the knowledge base - through better tools, system prompts, or skills?

• Voice-agents : The same agents, but on the phone - built on LiveKit, handling calls the way our text agents handle tickets.

• LLM Infrastructure. Pick the right model for the job, cache and stream to cut latency, retry when a provider fails, compact context, optimize RAG search, track usage across providers, reduce costs and run evals to see what's actually better.

Our minimalistic tech stack
Everything is TypeScript. From our database schema to the frontend.
Backend: Convex (Database & serverless functions)
Frontend: , React, Tailwind, shadcn/ui
Technologies you will encounter: Vercel AI SDK, Convex Agent Component
Salary

• $2000 - $4000 per month before taxes with room for growth and promotion in the months & years ahead

• Permanent employment contract in your country of residence through our partner Deel (EOR)

Benefits

• 100% remote work

• Allianz Gold Health Insurance with great coverage

• Flexible hours

• As many AI-tokens as you need

• We’re self-funded & profitable (and not burning VC money to survive)

• Small team, real ownership - what you build actually goes live

• Quick decisions, no pointless meetings and no layers of approval to get through

Our special Health Program

• Private room in hospital, worldwide coverage

• Free choice of doctors & specialists, no health check, pre-existing conditions don't matter

• Partner and kids are covered as well

• Surgery, cancer care, MRI/CT/PET scans and diagnostics fully covered

• Dental treatment & surgery covered at 90%

• $675/year for physio, osteopathy, chiropractic and acupuncture

• $100 per night in-patient cash benefit, up to 20 nights

• Prescription drugs, vaccinations, glasses/contacts, home nursing and ambulance covered

Our values

• Get things done, every day matters

• Transparency and honesty, especially when it’s hard

• Strive for greatness - Constantly challenge yourself and others

title: Field Marketer, North America
description:
As a Field Marketer, you will own regional field strategy and activation for Vena’s North American business, translating regional market opportunity, Sales priorities and Vena’s global go-to-market strategy into integrated activations that generate and progress pipeline. You will identify high-value audiences, segments and account concentrations, then determine and execute the right field marketing mix across Vena-led programs, partner-led activations, industry and community events, webinars and other targeted experiences. You will also extend Vena's corporate Marketing activations through the regional ecosystem, identifying opportunities to engage partners, customers, prospects and communities around priority market moments. As the connection between Vena Marketing organization, you will bring regional market intelligence into GTM planning and adapt campaigns, content and programs to support regional activations.

This is a highly collaborative, hands-on role that works closely across Marketing, Sales, Enablement, Partners and Ecosystem, to turn regional opportunities into measurable business pipeline and revenue impact.

How You'll Make an Impact

• Manage North American field marketing strategy and activation, translating regional market opportunity, target-account concentration, pipeline needs and Vena's GTM priorities into an integrated field marketing plan.

• Identify and prioritize high-value segments, audiences and market opportunities using pipeline, account and market intelligence, then recommend the field marketing plays most likely to generate or progress demand.

• Own the end-to-end execution of regional field programs, including Vena-led events, partner-led and co- in market activations, industry/community opportunities, webinars, and other targeted programs that drive results

• Extend Vena's corporate event and campaign investments through the regional ecosystem, partnering with Vena's Events and Marketing teams to activate relevant partners, customers, prospects and communities around priority market moments.

• Partner closely with Sales, Enablement, Ecosystem and broader Marketing organization to align to regional activation with target accounts, active pipeline and priority GTM plays.

• Drive field activation from concept through conversion, including audience strategy, promotion, content requirements, vendors/logistics, attendee experience, lead capture, Sales follow-up and post-program nurture.

• Measure success through qualified demand, pipeline creation, conversion and revenue impact, establishing clear tracking, attribution and reporting requirements.

• Translate Vena campaigns, content and enablement into regional activation, identifying where localization or regional requirements are needed and bringing those requirements back to the appropriate Marketing or Enablement owner.

• Build strong relationships with North American partners and identify where partner expertise, audiences, and distribution can strengthen GTM programs and shared pipeline goals.

• Act as the regional market intelligence loop, ensuring regional insights, buyer feedback, field learnings, competitive intelligence and program performance flow back into broader marketing planning.

• Other duties, as assigned.

We'd Love to See

• 5+ years of experience in B2B field marketing, integrated demand generation or partner marketing, ideally within EPM SaaS or a high growth technology company.

• Demonstrated ability to identify regional or segment-level growth opportunities and translate them into integrated field marketing programs that generate and progress pipeline.

• Experience owning programs end to end, from audience and segmentation strategy through execution, Sales follow-up, and measurement of pipeline impact.

• Demonstrated experience in executing repeatable in person programs and events that deliver our brand experience, elevate buyer and customer engagement and deliver measurable results.

• Exceptional collaboration

•
Bachelor's degree in Business, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

•
5+ years of experience in business operations, strategy, chief of staff roles, or technical program management, including direct support of senior leaders.

•
Proven experience managing operational tech stacks, vendor relationships, and tracking organizational budgets/OPEX or business cases.

•
Demonstrated ability to write and speak at a leadership altitude, holding the room and influencing cross-functional stakeholders without formal direct authority.

•
Exceptional ability to manage multiple complex threads, ensuring nothing is dropped, everything is documented, and decisions result in action.

•

•
Familiarity with cloud concepts (e.g., GCP, AWS, or Azure), cybersecurity, technical lab environments, or developer platforms.

•

Thrives in high ambiguity, capable of inventing structure when priorities shift rapidly across a distributed, global organization.

You will sit with the Head, be in the room for the decisions, carry their proxy, and govern the organization's technological, financial, and strategic resources. Ultimately, you will own the living story of the business, the cadence, the data narrative, and the cross-cutting initiatives that belong to no single team; ensuring leadership can speak to status, strategy, and risk at a moment's notice.

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.

OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves.

Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me , Do the Right Thing , and Get Things Done . These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er.

About the Team 

The Compliance function at OKX is responsible for the overall compliance program and culture of the company. We’re a team of risk-minded problem solvers who advise the business on the company’s regulatory obligations and enterprise risk.

About the Opportunity

The successful candidate will have prior transaction monitoring/investigations experience in the financial services, FinTech or cryptocurrency industries. You will help support the Special Investigations team, focusing on analyzing blockchain data to identify potential illicit activities, money laundering and terrorist financing, involving cryptocurrencies. The job requires a mix of technical expertise, investigative skills, and knowledge of crypto markets and blockchain technology.

 

What You’ll Be Doing

•
Conduct in-depth investigations of complex AML cases, ensuring thorough analysis and adherence to regulatory requirements, through investigation of blockchain transactions to track and identify suspicious or illicit activities such as money laundering, and other criminal activities.

•
Analyze data to identify process gaps and opportunities, and partner with Compliance, Training and other FIU stakeholders to recommend mitigating activities for risk and close process gaps.

•
Evaluate AML transaction monitoring and suspicious activity reporting requirements for all countries where applicable.

•
Collaborate with external partners, including financial institutions, government agencies, and blockchain companies, to share intelligence and insights. Work closely with law enforcement agencies, regulators, and legal teams to provide insights and evidence for criminal investigations.

•
Stay abreast of changes to the cryptocurrency industry, financial crime trends, and regulatory requirements to assess impact to Transaction Monitoring.

•
Support team training and knowledge sharing, fostering a collaborative environment focused on ongoing learning and professional growth.

What We Look For In You 

•
3-5 years of direct and strong technical experience in BSA/AML investigations and operations in relevant financial crimes, transaction monitoring and investigation roles.

•
Demonstrated knowledge of BSA/AML, KYC regulations, risks and controls implementation globally.

•
Strong understanding of blockchain technology, cryptocurrency protocols, and decentralized networks.

•
Experience performing in a fast-paced environment and proven ability to meet deadlines.

•
Self-motivated, critical thinker and adept at working independently and in a dispersed team environment covering multiple and varied tasks.

•
Intuitive, highly ethical, and comfortable to question and challenge the status quo.

•
Strong communication and presentation skills, both verbal and written. Proficiency in writing detailed investigative reports and communicating complex technical findings to non-technical stakeholders.

•
Experience working independently and with team members of all levels.

 

Nice to Haves  

•
Prior experience working in a multi-national or matrix environment.

•
Familiarity with commonly used transaction monitoring & reporting tool(s), such as Solidus Labs, Chainalysis, or Elliptic.

•
Relevant certifications in blockchain technology, digital

Trendyol Express ekibi olarak amacımız, her siparişte müşterilerimize kusursuz bir teslimat deneyimi sunmaktır. Müşteriyi her zaman odağımıza alarak; en ileri teknolojiyi, esnek operasyonel altyapıyı ve yenilikçi çözümleri bir araya getiriyoruz.
 
Hızlı ve iş birliğine dayalı çalışma kültürümüz sayesinde; veri, çeviklik ve güçlü ekip ruhu ile her zorluğu fırsata dönüştürüyoruz. Bölgesel olarak büyürken, lojistikte yeni standartlar belirliyor ve attığımız her adımda kalıcı değer yaratmak için çalışıyoruz.

Trendyol’da Sizi Neler Bekliyor?
- FlexBenefits: Günlük yemek bütçeni özelleştirebilir, sağlık sigortanı upgrade edebilir, akaryakıt desteği veya Trendyol alışveriş bakiyesi gibi ek haklar arasından ihtiyacına göre seçim yapabilirsin.
- İyi yaşam desteği: Lokasyon bazlı kurum içi doktorlarımızdan, psikolog ve diyetisyen desteğinden ve HPV aşısı kapsamından faydalanabilirsin.
- Kişiselleştirilmiş öğrenme ve gelişim fırsatları: Yıllık eğitim bütçeni ihtiyacana uygun olduğunu düşündüğün eğitim veya konferans için kullanabilirsin. LMS platformumuzdan dilediğin an faydalanabilir, yıl boyu sunulan yüz yüze eğitimlere katılabilirsin.
- İlk günden sorumluluk alma kültürü: Trendyol’da her ses duyulur ve değer görür. Sen de daha ilk günden itibaren inisiyatif alarak etki yaratabilirsin.
- Tek ruhlu, çok kültürlü bir ekip: Berlin’den Dubai’ye, Amsterdam’dan İstanbul’a... Farklı bakış açılarını bir araya getiren, start-up ruhuyla çalışan uluslararası bir ekibiz.

Bu rol seni heyecanlandırdıysa hemen başvur, bir sonraki adımı birlikte atalım.

title: REO Asset Manager
description:
Portfolio & Asset Management

• Manage a high-volume portfolio of residential REO assets across multiple markets nationwide.

• Develop and execute disposition strategies designed to maximize investor returns while meeting client performance objectives.

• Monitor portfolio performance metrics, service level agreements (SLAs), timelines, and key operational benchmarks.

• Analyze market conditions, inventory trends, property performance, and buyer demand to optimize pricing and sales strategies.

• Provide regular reporting, forecasting, and recommendations to clients and leadership regarding asset performance and market conditions.

Property Oversight & Value Optimization

• Evaluate asset-specific opportunities to increase net recovery through repairs, renovations, occupancy strategies, and targeted marketing initiatives.

• Review and approve property budgets, vendor recommendations, preservation costs, and capital improvement requests.

• Partner with property management, field services, and vendor networks to ensure assets are maintained, secured, and positioned for sale while minimizing expenses and liability exposure.

• Identify and escalate asset-related risks, compliance issues, operational challenges, and process improvements.

Sales & Disposition Management

• Oversee the disposition process from pre-listing through closing, ensuring timely execution and compliance with client requirements.

• Determine appropriate marketing channels, including traditional MLS listings, online auction offerings, and bulk sale strategies.

• Evaluate offers, negotiate contract terms, secure required approvals, and facilitate successful transaction closings.

• Collaborate with sales, marketing, and product teams to increase asset visibility and drive buyer engagement.

Valuation & Market Analysis

• Review broker price opinions (BPOs), appraisals, comparative market analyses, and valuation reports to support pricing decisions.

• Partner with valuation providers and appraisal teams to reconcile property values and challenge assumptions when appropriate.

• Conduct financial and market analysis to support strategic recommendations and portfolio planning.

Client & Stakeholder Management

• Serve as a trusted advisor for investors, clients, servicing partners, brokers, and buyers throughout the asset lifecycle.

• Maintain proactive communication regarding portfolio performance, asset strategy, market conditions, and transaction status.

• Develop strong working relationships with internal and external stakeholders to drive operational excellence and customer satisfaction.

• Support client meetings, portfolio reviews, and business development initiatives as needed.

Systems & Compliance

• Maintain accurate asset records, documentation, and transaction activity within Equator and other asset management platforms.

• Ensure compliance with investor guidelines, regulatory requirements, company policies, and established procedures.

• Monitor foreclosure timelines, title issues, and transaction milestones to mitigate delays and reduce risk.

Required Experience

• 3+ years of experience in REO asset management, default servicing, real estate disposition, or related real estate operations.

• Experience managing institutional or large-scale residential real estate portfolios.

• Proven experience negotiating real estate transactions and managing assets through disposition.

Knowledge & Skills

• Strong knowledge of foreclosure, REO, loss mitigation, title, escrow, and residential real estate transaction processes.

• Working knowledge of HUD, FHA, VA, GSE, and investor servicing requirements.

• Understanding of real estate auction platforms and disposition strategies, including online auction sales.

• Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret market trends, property valuations, and financial data.

• Excellent negotiation, communication, relationship management, and problem-solving abilities.

• Proficiency with Microsoft

title: Quality & Compliance Manager, Computer System Validation
description:
JOB SUMMARY

The Quality & Compliance Manager, Computer System Validation manages the quality oversight and lifecycle validation of GxP computerized systems supporting CRO and laboratory operations. The role partners with Quality, IT, system owners, operational teams, and external providers to ensure systems are fit for intended use, maintain data integrity, and remain compliant and inspection-ready from implementation through retirement. The Manager establishes consistent, risk-based computer system assurance practices and drives continuous improvement across clinical and laboratory environments.

 

MAIN DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

• Provide independent, risk-based Quality Assurance oversight of GxP computerized systems throughout the system lifecycle, from initial assessment and implementation through operation, periodic review, significant change, and retirement.

• Review and approve applicable validation and assurance deliverables, including system risk assessments, validation plans, requirements, traceability documentation, test evidence, deviations, validation summary reports, and release-readiness documentation. Confirm that testing is appropriately planned, executed, documented, and traceable without assuming responsibility for business-owned testing or project execution.

• Ensure computerized systems are fit for intended use, maintain data integrity, and comply with applicable internal procedures, client commitments, and regulatory requirements, including requirements relevant to electronic records, electronic signatures, audit trails, access controls, security, backup, archival, and record retention.

• Provide QA oversight for computerized systems supporting clinical research and laboratory activities, including clinical platforms, laboratory information systems, electronic laboratory notebooks, chromatography data systems, instrument software, interfaces, automated workflows, and associated data repositories, as applicable to the role’s scope.

• Oversee the ongoing validated state of computerized systems by evaluating changes, incidents, deviations, corrective and preventive actions, upgrades, data migrations, periodic reviews, and decommissioning activities. Identify and escalate compliance or data-integrity risks and verify that appropriate remediation is completed and documented

• Support the qualification and ongoing oversight of software, cloud, data, and computerized-system service providers. Partner with Quality, IT, Information Security, Clinical Operations, Laboratory Operations, system owners, and vendors to clarify accountabilities and ensure that adequate controls are established and maintained.

• Develop, maintain, and improve policies, procedures, templates, tools, and training for computer system validation and computer software assurance. Promote consistent, scalable, and risk-based practices across CRO and laboratory environments.

• Prepare for and support sponsor audits, regulatory inspections, and internal audits involving computerized systems. Ensure validation records are complete, accurate, readily retrievable, and inspection-ready, and coordinate responses to observations within the role’s area of responsibility.

• Establish and report meaningful metrics for validation status, lifecycle compliance, overdue activities, deviations, CAPAs, supplier performance, and emerging risks. Use trends and lessons learned to drive continuous improvement and communicate significant issues to Quality and business leadership.

• Bachelor’s degree in life sciences, computer science, information systems, engineering, healthcare, or another relevant scientific or technical discipline.

• A minimum of six years of progressively responsible experience in Quality Assurance, computer system validation, computer software assurance, information technology quality, or related discipline within a regulated life sciences environment.

title: Head of Simulation Engineering (Expression of Interest)
description:
Expression of Interest · Inquire First
We are meeting senior leaders for this planned function as we fundraise. This is an exploratory conversation, not an immediately funded salaried vacancy or a guaranteed start date. No cash salary is available today; any equity arrangement must be agreed separately. You are not being asked to begin work by expressing interest.
Use the Apply form below to introduce yourself and indicate your interest. We can discuss mutual fit, scope, funding, compensation, and timing before either side makes a commitment.
Remote · United States · Full time · Functional leadership
Turn simulation research into an experimental engine that can be inspected, reproduced, and improved. Lead the engineering function at the boundary between scientific methods and dependable software.
Why Subconscious

Subconscious is building the intelligence to run the economy. We start with a simulator for business decisions, using causal experiments on simulated markets to test products, pricing, messaging, and go-to-market choices before capital is committed. The long-term ambition is to help businesses discover unmet demand and build around what people actually need.
The function you will build
Own simulation implementation, experiment execution semantics, reproducibility standards, and the simulation engineering hiring plan. Partner with causal research on method design, evaluation on quality, and infrastructure on reliable operation.
This is a hands-on leadership role. Set the functional roadmap and propose staffing and spending priorities with the founding team. Hiring and budget commitments depend on approved resources; an established team or funded budget is not assumed.
Proposed first 90 days after joining
Use these as an initial agenda, refined with the founders against the product, customer needs, and resources at your start.

• Trace an experiment from configuration to output and document which inputs, model versions, random states, and artifacts are required to reproduce it.

• Establish an implementation contract for treatments, populations, execution, and result aggregation, with meaningful correctness checks.

• Profile a representative workload and improve its largest quality, throughput, or cost constraint without silently changing the experimental question.

• Build a research-to-production path with versioned interfaces, reviewable changes, and explicit failure handling.

How we will judge progress
Research ideas become reusable capabilities with explainable behavior. Track reproducibility, correctness under independently specified test cases, experiment throughput, and cost. Make changes in model behavior distinguishable from execution defects.
What you bring

• You have led research engineering, simulation, scientific computing, or ML systems work and shipped robust implementations of complex methods.

• You can reason about stochastic systems, numerical behavior, experiment design, and performance while writing and reviewing production code.

• You can lead a technical roadmap across researchers and engineers and make explicit tradeoffs between exploration and stability.

We are looking for evidence of judgment, execution, and leadership. A particular company pedigree or previous executive title is not a substitute for that evidence.
Compensation and funding
We are actively fundraising. Only equity-based compensation is currently available; no cash salary is available today. The equity grant and its terms have not been set for this role and must be agreed before joining. Any future salary, incentive plan, benefits, hiring budget, or paid start date depends on financing and written agreement. Funding and its timing are not guaranteed.
Before deciding to join, discuss the grant structure, fully diluted ownership basis, vesting, dilution, applicable exercise terms, company funding position, and working arrangement. A company valuation is not the cash value of an equity grant.

title: Principal Storage Architect
description:
About Graphcore

Graphcore is a leading innovator in artificial intelligence computing. We develop hardware, software, and data center infrastructure that provide the specialized processing and systems capabilities needed to advance AI while improving the efficiency required for broad adoption.

As part of SoftBank Group, Graphcore works alongside companies developing advanced technologies. Our teams bring together AI researchers, silicon designers, hardware and software engineers, and systems architects to solve complex technical problems across the computing stack.

The Opportunity

As Principal Storage Architect, you will define the high-performance storage architecture for Graphcore's AI computing and data center infrastructures.   You will lead the design of local and distributed storage tiers that provide the throughput, availability, and predictable tail latency required for large-scale training and inference.

Working within Advanced Architecture, you will address storage requirements for saving model states, offloading key-value caches, large datasets, and high-speed data-loading pipelines.   You will combine hands-on performance engineering with Principal-level technical leadership across hardware, software, networking, systems engineering, automation, supply chain, and external technology partners.

What You Will Do

• Define the end-to-end architecture and technology roadmap for local, disaggregated, and distributed storage across Graphcore AI server and data center platforms.

• Design storage topologies that optimize PCIe lane allocation, network-domain placement, and data paths among CPUs, AI accelerators, memory, and storage systems.

• Lead the architecture of storage control-plane and data-plane solutions, evaluating commercial and open technologies against performance, resilience, manageability, and lifecycle requirements.

• Profile and tune the Linux storage stack, block layer, I/O schedulers, direct I/O paths, file systems, and drivers to improve IOPS, bandwidth, and 99.99th-percentile latency.

• Optimize storage for AI workloads, including model checkpointing, key-value cache offload, data ingestion, and direct data movement between NVMe storage and accelerator memory.

• Set the technical direction for NVMe SSD lifecycle management, including qualification, provisioning, health monitoring, firmware rollout, failure handling, and warranty-return automation across E1.S, E3.S, U.2, and U.3 devices.

• Define telemetry and alerting requirements for direct-attached and distributed storage, including endurance, wear, drive writes per day, thermals, capacity, performance, and latency anomalies.

• Provide architecture requirements and technical guidance to automation teams building frameworks that characterize storage performance, reliability, and compatibility across AI platforms.

• Lead root-cause analysis for complex storage failures and performance degradation across Linux kernels, drivers, PCIe, networks, SSD firmware, and third-party storage systems.

• Partner with storage vendors, supply chain, networking, systems engineering, and product teams to select, integrate, and deploy storage components and platforms.

• Evaluate emerging storage, interconnect, and memory-tiering technologies and translate relevant developments into platform requirements and future system designs.

What You Will Bring

• A bachelor's or equivalent experience or master's degree in computer science, computer engineering, information technology, electrical engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

• Extensive hands-on experience in storage engineering and architecture for AI, high-performance computing, hyperscale, or large data center environments, including technical leadership at Principal, Staff, or Lead Architect scope.

• Deep knowledge of NVMe, PCIe Gen5 or Gen6 architecture, NAND flash behavior, SSD form factors, endurance, firmware, and device lifecycle management.

Job Description Summary:
The Prenatal-to-3 Policy Impact Center aims to accelerate states’ implementation of evidence-based policies that help all children thrive from the start.
We seek an experienced Senior Research Data Analyst to provide data management and analysis expertise to projects across the Center. The role primarily includes original survey and program data cleaning, data management, and statistical analyses for a portfolio of original research and evaluation projects. The Policy Impact Center’s research seeks to build the evidence base in key areas related to the impact of state policies and programs on outcomes for infants, toddlers, and their families. The role of the Senior Research Data Analyst is essential for transforming raw data into research assets, ensuring the validity and credibility of the Center’s research, resolving complex data challenges, and supporting timely research-based deliverables.
This Senior Research Data Analyst position provides essential data expertise and rigorous analytic support and guidance to a team of data researchers responsible for supporting the Center’s goals to build the evidence base for effective and equitable policymaking, track state progress in building a more effective and equitable system of care, and shape policy development in states through targeted assistance and support.

title: Narrative Designer
description:
About the game
Hopetown is a new narrative-first RPG inspired by Disco Elysium, being built by some of the team that worked on Disco Elysium, including Martin Luiga (founder of the ZA/UM Cultural Movement, writer of several characters on Disco Elysium, writer of the first short story in the Disco Elysium world), Lenval Brown (narrator of Disco Elysium) and Piotr Sobolewski (former CEO of Knights of U, which completed all the tech for Disco Elysium).
We are currently moving into early production, building out the foundational systems, characters, and mechanics that will define the experience. With your help, we can transform Hopetown from a great cRPG into an unforgettable one - a living, breathing universe of stories, surprises, and challenges.
About us
Longdue is a studio founded to create rich, emotional, story-first games that challenge players’ expectations. We’re a remote team of writers, artists, designers, and engineers, bringing together talent from across the industry to push the boundaries of narrative-driven RPGs.
We are still early in production, meaning new team members will have a real, tangible impact on the world we are building. We believe that extraordinary games can come from small, focused teams that value creativity, openness, and care over convention.
About the role
We’re looking for a Lead Narrative Designer with both creative and production instincts - someone who can shape Hopetown’s story while helping to build the systems and structures that make great narrative work possible.
You’ll lead a small team of writers through the early stages of development, balancing storytelling vision with clear planning, coordination, and delivery. You’ll collaborate closely with design, production, and tech to align narrative goals with development milestones and to ensure the narrative team’s output fits smoothly into the broader pipeline.
This role sits at the intersection of creativity and operations - ideal for someone who loves story but also thrives on clarity, structure, and collaboration.

Requirements
MUST-HAVE REQUIREMENTS

• 5+ years of experience leading and/or managing a narrative team on a narrative-first game, ideally in the RPG space.

• Proven ability to plan, organise, and deliver narrative work within production milestones, experience coordinating pipelines, tracking progress, and aligning with design or production teams

• Proven experience writing emotionally resonant, character-driven stories

• Experience overseeing multiple writers’ work and overseeing edits to ensure cohesion in both tone and style

• Excellent communication, documentation, and cross-functional collaboration skills

title: Sales Development Manager
description:
About OpenSesame

OpenSesame is transforming workforce development with an AI-powered marketplace of skill-building courses and learning pathways. We help organizations build skills and stay compliant through a high-quality content catalog, seamless LMS/LXP integrations, and advanced capabilities like skills-based curation and multilingual content creation. More than 2,000 companies, including 150+ of the Global 2000, rely on OpenSesame to develop the world's most productive and admired workforces.

Learn more: www.opensesame.com/about

About the Team 

OpenSesame is entering a new phase of growth - evolving from a product-led to a multi-product, AI-enhanced SaaS company. The Sales Development (SDR) team sits at the forefront of this transformation. As our Sales Development Manager you’ll lead the team that fuels our outbound pipeline, engages in meaningful conversations with L&D and HR leaders, and sets the standard for what modern, human-centered, AI-powered outbound looks like.

About the Role 

This role is about more than managing activity. You’ll scale a predictable outbound engine, develop future sales talent, and redefine how OpenSesame connects with the market - through a balance of technology, creativity, and empathy.

You’ll blend strategy and execution, building an SDR function that leverages AI tools to enhance research, messaging and timely coaching, while keeping the human touch at the heart of every interaction. You will work closely with Marketing, Partners, Sales, Enablement and RevOps, to turn insight into action - driving pipeline growth, process consistency, and professional development across the team.

Reporting to the Director of GTM Operations, this is a highly visible leadership role with a direct impact on pipeline, revenue and GTM innovation.

Performance Objectives 

First 30 Days - Orientation & Assessment

• Build a foundational understanding of OpenSesame’s go-to-market strategy, ideal customer profiles, and competitive landscape.

• Audit existing SDR processes, messaging, and cadences across Gong Engage, Salesforce, and ZoomInfo.

• Assess SDR performance metrics (activity → meeting, meeting → opportunity, velocity) and identify key bottlenecks.

• Conduct 1:1s with every SDR, AE, and cross-functional partner to understand strengths, challenges, and development goals.

• Deliver a baseline performance report and outline 2-3 high-impact quick wins to drive immediate improvement.

• Outline an execution plan for automated inbound management.

Success by Day 30: Clear SDR performance baseline, planned approach for early optimizations, and a 10+% improvement in activity-to-meeting conversion through data-driven tweaks and workflow efficiency.

By 60 Days - Optimization & Team Enablement

• Launch the first version of the AI-Enhanced Outbound Playbook, integrating tools like Gong Engage, Qualified, Clay, ZoomInfo and ChatGPT Enterprise to automate research, personalization drafts, lead qualification and post-call notes.

• Coach SDRs on balancing automation with authentic outreach, reinforcing high-quality engagement and messaging consistency.

• Partner with Marketing to launch 2-3 account-based outbound campaigns targeting top verticals and / or target account lists.

• Engage with our Partner organization to improve and enhance our Partner lead processes

• Establish a weekly coaching rhythm using Gong analytics, call reviews, and performance dashboards to ensure feedback is timely and impactful.

• Optimize existing dashboards that track inbound and outbound conversion, pipeline creation, and ROI in real time.

• Establish a closed loop feedback process for capturing seller and sales leader insights in order to continuously improve SDR support.

Success by Day 60: SDRs are operating with greater precision and confidence, with 5-7% improvement in meeting-to-opportunity conversion rates, and new playbook adoption exceeding 90%.

title: ServiceNow Developer
description:
Hi there! Thanks for stopping by 👋

Are you actively looking for a new opportunity? Or just checking the market? Well… you might just be in the right place!

We are looking for a hands-on ServiceNow Developer to join our IT Platform team. This person will own the day-to-day configuration, development, and support of our ServiceNow instance, working across ITSM & HRSD while helping extend the platform through custom development and third-party integrations. This is a highly technical, delivery-focused role for someone who enjoys building, troubleshooting, and continuously improving a mission-critical enterprise platform.

You'll work across our development, staging, and production instances, partner closely with IT and business stakeholders, and help drive our upgrade and enhancement roadmap forward.

What you’ll be doing:

- Develop and configure ServiceNow: Build and maintain applications, catalog items, record producers, workflows, Business Rules, Client Scripts, UI Policies, Script Includes, UI Actions, and other platform components.

- Build integrations: Design, develop, and troubleshoot integrations between ServiceNow and third-party systems using REST/SOAP APIs, OAuth, webhooks, Integration Hub, MCP, and iPaaS platforms such as Workato.

- Maintain and optimize the platform: Monitor platform health, troubleshoot performance issues, optimize scripts and flows, and ensure solutions remain scalable and maintainable.

- Support ServiceNow applications like ITSM & HRSD: Help deliver and improve Incident, Problem, Change, Request, and HR-related workflows and automations.

- Manage access and security: Administer roles, ACLs, permissions, and other platform access controls in line with security and audit requirements.

- Resolve complex issues: Act as an escalation point for platform-level incidents, perform root cause analysis, and coordinate with infrastructure, security, vendors, and other technical teams when issues span multiple systems.

- Deliver enhancements and projects: Partner with stakeholders to gather requirements, prioritize the backlog, design solutions, and take work through development, testing, deployment, and post-launch support.

- Drive platform consistency: Establish reusable development patterns and standards for workflows, notifications, approvals, documentation, and user experiences.

- Support upgrades and releases: Evaluate new ServiceNow releases, test upgrades, remediate breaking changes, and adopt relevant new platform capabilities.

- Document and enable: Maintain technical documentation, runbooks, integration documentation, and user procedures, and provide support or training when needed.

What you need to bring:

- Hands-on experience developing and administering ServiceNow, ideally across ITSM and/or HRSD.

- Strong JavaScript skills, including ServiceNow scripting APIs such as GlideRecord and GlideAjax.

- Experience with Flow Designer, Business Rules, Script Includes, Client Scripts, UI Policies, UI Actions, ACLs, and Service Catalog development.

- Experience designing and troubleshooting REST/SOAP integrations, OAuth, webhooks, and enterprise integrations.

- Strong understanding of ITSM processes and how they translate into ServiceNow solutions.

- Ability to independently troubleshoot complex issues across ServiceNow and connected systems.

- Strong problem-solving, communication, and documentation skills.

- Experience working with stakeholders to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions.

- Comfortable managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Nice to have's

- Experience with HRSD, ITOM, Workday, or identity/HR platforms.

- Experience with ServiceNow AI/GenAI capabilities, including Now Assist.

- Experience with MCP (Model Context Protocol) and MCP-enabled tools or workflows.

- Experience with Service Portal, custom widgets, HTML, and CSS.

- Experience with Workato or other iPaaS platforms.

- ServiceNow CSA or CAD, or ITIL 4 Foundation

title: Head of Growth
description:
About LumiMeds

LumiMeds is a fast-growing U.S.-based telehealth startup focused on weight management and long-term metabolic health. We are building the next generation of e-commerce and clinical infrastructure from the ground up.

As an early-stage company, we move quickly, operate with limited layers, and expect high ownership from every team member. There is no bureaucracy here - decisions happen fast, priorities evolve, and builders thrive.

We are a remote-first, globally distributed team that values clarity, accountability, and people who take initiative rather than wait for direction.

Head of Growth - LumiMeds

Location: Remote | Type: Full-time | Reports to: Founder/CEO

About LumiMeds

LumiMeds is a fast-growing telehealth company making GLP-1 weight-loss treatment (semaglutide & tirzepatide) accessible, affordable, and effective. We've built a real business with real patients and real outcomes - and we're just getting started. We move fast, test relentlessly, and let data settle arguments.

The Role

We're hiring a Head of Growth to own our growth engine end-to-end - online and offline. This is not a channel-manager seat. You'll set the growth strategy, run experiments across every lever (paid, organic, referral, partnerships, experiential, OOH, guerrilla), and personally drive the initiatives that move the business. You bring a playbook of proven tactics, the scrappiness to execute them on a lean budget, and the analytical rigor to know what's actually working.

If you've grown a consumer business from scratch, thrive in ambiguity, and get a thrill out of finding the unlock nobody else saw - this is your seat.

What You'll Do

•
Own the full growth strategy across digital and offline channels - you set the roadmap and the number you're accountable to.

•
Run growth end-to-end: ideation → hypothesis → execution → measurement → iterate. You don't hand things off; you drive them to the finish.

•
Build and scale offline growth initiatives - experiential, OOH, guerrilla, events, partnerships, retail, and channels we haven't thought of yet.

•
Scale digital acquisition - paid social/search, lifecycle, referral, affiliate, SEO/content - and squeeze efficiency out of every dollar.

•
Bring proven playbooks - you've done this before and can point to specific tactics that worked, and why.

•
Research relentlessly - find new channels, size opportunities, study competitors, and pressure-test ideas before we spend.

•
Negotiate with vendors and partners - you get more for less and structure deals that de-risk our spend.

•
Live in the data - instrument everything, measure CAC/LTV/payback obsessively, and kill what doesn't work fast.

What You Bring

•
Track record of growing a business - you can show real numbers you were directly responsible for moving.

•
Both offline and digital growth experience - you're equally comfortable running a guerrilla campaign and a paid-acquisition dashboard.

•
A documented playbook of growth tactics you've run and can run again.

•
True growth-hacker DNA - scrappy, resourceful, and biased toward action on a lean budget.

•
Data-driven decision-making - you form hypotheses, run clean tests, and follow the numbers.

•
End-to-end ownership - you take an idea from napkin to launched, measured, and scaled.

•
Strong research and negotiation skills - you find the opportunity and close the deal.

• Bonus: DTC, subscription, telehealth, wellness, or regulated-vertical experience.

Why LumiMeds

• Direct access to the founder and a mandate to move fast.

• A real product with proven demand and outcomes - you're pouring fuel on a fire, not starting one.

• Full ownership of growth, with the budget and autonomy to prove your playbook.

How to Apply

If this role sounds like a fit, we’d love to hear from you. Please submit your application in English and ensure your resume reflects relevant experience for the role.

title: Elektronik-Ingenieur
description: About pplwise pplwise is a recruiting consultancy for fast-growing technology companies across Europe. Through Recruiting as a Service and Executive Search, we fill key roles for our clients, from start-ups to publicly listed companies. We are filling this position for our client Filics. About our client: Filics Filics is reinventing intralogistics with autonomous mobile robots (AMRs) that change how material moves. Its double-runner system makes Filics the first and only AMR that can drive through load carriers such as Euro pallets. This breaks with forklift logic and sets a new standard for efficiency. Filics is a small, hands-on team that solves hard problems with engineering excellence. Leadership goes to those who take initiative and consistently deliver. As Senior Electrical Engineer (m/f/d) at Filics, you will design the electronics at the core of the next generation of robots. About the role This is an on-site/hybrid role in Munich, close to engineering and assembly. Filics doesn’t just use off-the-shelf components. It builds its own custom IP. The robots run on advanced boards that cover a wide range of electrical engineering. On one end is high power, such as battery and motor controllers. On the other end are high-speed interfaces like PCIe, USB and MIPI CSI. The real challenge is making all these subsystems work together as one system. Many of these problems have no textbook solution. Solving them takes solid experience, a deep understanding of the physics and a creative mind. The EE team is small, and the robot is far from finished. You’ll own your boards end to end : requirements, system design, schematic, layout, design review, sourcing, manufacturing, testing and validation. You’ll keep owning them for as long as they’re in prod
